name: tesor_gp
description: StreamVerse: Web3 pay-as-you-watch streaming on Polygon

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @tesor_gp/shared && npm run build -w @tesor_gp/storage && npm run build -w @tesor_gp/blockchain && npm run build -w @tesor_gp/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,chain-sdk,api,worker,ai,web -c gray,gray,blue,magenta,yellow,green "npm run dev -w @tesor_gp/shared" "npm run dev -w @tesor_gp/blockchain" "npm run dev -w @tesor_gp/api" "npm run dev -w @tesor_gp/worker-video-processor" "npm run dev -w @tesor_gp/ai" "npm run dev -w @tesor_gp/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @tesor_gp/e2e
